latest_release.name: Release build - 1.24.1b (2026-11-06)
latest_release.body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-123/

## New Features
- Updated to Firefox 159.0.1
- New grain options have been added to the theme picker. You can cycle through different grain effects by clicking on the circle inside the dial.

## Fixes
- Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Zen restarts to apply an update.
- Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram.
- Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled.
- Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- On macOS, icons on the UI will now start using SF Symbols.
- The 'About Zen' window has been redesigned.
- 'My Review Request' option for Pull Requests live folder now searches for 'user-review-requested:@me' instead of 'review-requested:@me'
